subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.

A guru is someone who does not charge you a fee because someone who is tied in greed couldn’t release you.

options.text: charge you a fee because someone
who is tied in greed couldn’t release you.
A guru is someone who does not

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in **'Option 2'.**
 
• The given sentence is in** present simple tense.**
 
• '**Can't' **will be used instead of **'couldn't.'**

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'A guru is someone who does not charge you a fee because someone who is tied in greed** can't **release you.'*
